title: Keyboard navigation between connected nodes (Tab/Arrow keys)
description: Implement keyboard-based navigation between connected nodes. When a node is focused, pressing Tab or Arrow keys should move focus to connected nodes (upstream/downstream in the value stream). This leverages React Flow's built-in accessibility support (aria defaults, keyboard controls) but adds graph-aware navigation. Users can press Enter to open the side panel for the focused node. This is critical for accessibility (WCAG compliance) and also benefits power users who prefer keyboard workflows. Reference: React Flow v11+ has built-in a11y support including keyboard controls and aria defaults. Synergy Codes has published an ebook on building accessible diagrams with React Flow.
